decisions.title: Import strategy: absolute projectsetup3.src.* (keep src/ as subpackage)
decisions.context: After manual reorg (commit af132c3 + moves into src/core/Services/Egine/core/), imports split into three conflicting styles (projectsetup3.src.*, projectsetup3.core.*, bare core.*). Layout is hybrid: pyproject uses packages.find where=['.'] include=['projectsetup3*'], so src/ is a real subpackage (projectsetup3.src), not a true src-layout.
decisions.decision: Canonical imports become absolute projectsetup3.src.* (e.g. projectsetup3.src.core.tool, projectsetup3.src.config.Config). Do NOT move src/* into the package root; src/ stays as a subpackage.
alternatives: absolute_flat projectsetup3.* (would require moving src/* to package root - rejected by user)
consequences: All broken imports normalized to projectsetup3.src.*
sys.path hacks that shadow the real package must be neutralized

decisions.title: Scope: strict package/import/runtime/packaging normalization
decisions.context: ProjectManagerService was renamed ProjectService (git-verified: same class, same API). But ProjectService.create_project changed from @staticmethod to instance method, and domain model methods (Project.openBaseCodeJson/create/add_History/getBasestruture, Project.setLanguage writing self.language, ProjectFactory referencing self.language with no fields) are broken pre-existing logic bugs.
decisions.decision: This task only normalizes package/import/runtime/packaging consistency. Domain/API logic bugs (Project, ProjectFactory, ProjectService static-vs-instance) are OUT-OF-SCOPE and documented, not fixed.
alternatives: Expand scope to fix domain logic (rejected by user: 'pure' scope).
consequences: Path renames only (ProjectManagerService -> ProjectService import path), no behavior change
test/t.py and full end-to-end CLI creation flow remain broken at the domain level
